llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究SLM AlSi10Mg合金的微观应力-应变关系，不涉及生物医学植入物、多孔结构或骨整合。
llm.why_not_core: Does not address biomedical implants, porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue testing, surface roughness, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究SLM成形AlSi10Mg合金中不同相的应力-应变关系
summary_zh.method: 采用晶体塑性有限元方法模拟微观力学行为
summary_zh.result: 获得了各相的内禀应力应变曲线
summary_zh.validation: 理论模型验证，无实验测试

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the stress-strain response of individual phases in AlSi10Mg alloy fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Crystal plasticity finite element method (CPFEM) is used to simulate the micro-mechanical behavior of the constituent phases.
summary_en.result: The intrinsic stress-strain curves of different phases are obtained from the crystal plasticity model.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; the study relies on theoretical modeling.
